newsitem.title: USA: United Technologies rises after report.
newsitem.headline: United Technologies rises after report.

text.p: United Technologies Corp shares surged 3-3/8 to 138-3/8 after a favorable article in Barron's.

The article said George David, president and chief executive of United Tech, "has engineered a remarkable turnaround at United since assuming the helm of the company in 1992, a task made all the more difficult by the wide array of businesses the conglomerate owns."

Barron's said the company's earnings "jumped some 28 percent last year alone, to a record $750 million, or $5.70 a share, and seem a cinch to rise another 20 percent or so this year to around $6.80 a share."
"Analysts look for more double-digit profit gains in 1997 and 1998, as well," the publication said.
Barron's said the stock has been rising in advance of a two-for-one split planned for early December.
